godofthings.configuration.advanced_alloy: One entry per line: recipe ID pattern,tier. Supports * wildcards; tiers range from 0 to 10; unmatched recipes are unrestricted.

godofthings.configuration.ae_batch_ripe_: How many ticks the Advanced Alloy Furnace waits after receiving a pushed AE batch before starting it. This window merges consecutive pushes into a single task; the task shows as "Queued" while waiting. Set to 0 to start immediately; the window is always skipped when the machine is completely idle (no running task)

How many ticks the Advanced Alloy Furnace waits after receiving a pushed AE batch before starting it. This window merges consecutive pushes into a single task; the task shows as "Queued" while waiting. Set to 0 to start immediately; the window is always skipped when the machine is completely idle (no running task)
godofthings.configuration.ae_output_retu: How many milliseconds per tick the Advanced Alloy Furnace may spend writing outputs back into the ME network. This directly sets the sustainable crafting speed: AE2 storage accepts only one long chunk per call, so outputs must be inserted chunk by chunk and the per-tick insert count is what limits throughput. Higher = faster crafting but a heavier tick (may cost TPS); lower = cheaper tick but slower crafting. The budget is further scaled down by the global throttle when the machine or server is overloaded (floor 250 microseconds)

godofthings.configuration.ae_unlimited_b: When enabled, removes the material-window cap on a single batch (the threads x Long.MAX gate). Batch size is then decided solely by output delivery capacity, so one dispatch can absorb arbitrarily large counts without stacking thread counts. Trade-off: a single admission may take an extremely large amount of materials (deducted by the caller's own BigInteger ledger); low-tier coils then fall back to the energy gate instead, while the useful coil (no energy gate) is unaffected

manual.godofthings.creative_energy_cube:
What: Creative Energy Cube -- an infinite FE source; all six faces output at maximum rate (infinite FE/t).
Obtain: creative tab.
Use: right-click for a GUI that charges you or your items.
manual.godofthings.creature_annihilation:
What: Creature Annihilation -- while placed, natural mob spawning is blocked within a 512-block radius.
Obtain: crafting.
Use: just place it in your base; no GUI.
manual.godofthings.god_absorber:
What: God Absorber -- absorbs item drops and XP over a large area.
Obtain: crafting.
Use: GUI for on/off, range (0-1600), stored-XP panel and per-face config; can join an AE2 network.
manual.godofthings.god_accelerator:
What: parallel accelerator -- goes into a God machine's accelerator slot; each one multiplies parallel jobs by 16 (a stack of 64 = x1024).
Obtain: crafting / creative tab.
Use: open the machine GUI and put it in the accelerator slot. Affects miner, resource, drop machines, etc.
manual.godofthings.god_binder:
What: binds a machine to the God Transmitter's wireless charging network.
Obtain: crafting.
Use: right-click a machine to bind it; holding it in the off hand auto-binds machines you place.
manual.godofthings.god_black_box:
What: pickup filter storage -- whitelist or blacklist mode, no stack limit inside.
Obtain: crafting.
Use: right-click for the filter GUI; scroll while holding it to toggle quickly.
manual.godofthings.god_boots:
What: God Boots -- one of the four God Armor pieces.
Obtain: crafting.
Use: wear all four pieces to activate set features.
manual.godofthings.god_change:
What: time / weather control.
Obtain: crafting.
Use: right-click to open the GUI and pick the time and weather to switch to.
manual.godofthings.god_chestplate:
What: God Chestplate -- one of the four God Armor pieces.
Obtain: crafting.
Use: wear all four pieces to activate set features.
manual.godofthings.god_craft:
What: God Craft -- an advanced crafting table with a config menu, 8 template slots and even-input distribution.
Obtain: crafting.
Use: right-click for the GUI; templates save/reapply your common recipes. Can join an AE2 network.
manual.godofthings.god_devourer:
What: God Devourer -- a void trash can.
Obtain: crafting.
Use: right-click the block for its GUI; there is also a quick button in the player inventory. **Contents are destroyed when you close the GUI.**
manual.godofthings.god_drop:
What: God Drop -- item collector plus spawn-egg producer. Eggs are not consumed; it rolls the **vanilla loot table** and outputs every drop (e.g. chicken = feather + raw chicken, 64 of each), filtering out weapons/tools/armor so it is not a free-gear machine.
Obtain: crafting.
Use: **since v5.7.0 every mod's spawn egg works** (not just vanilla); put spawn eggs in the input slots (up to 9 in parallel); God Accelerator raises parallelism; can join an AE2 network.
manual.godofthings.god_enchant:
What: God Enchant -- an enchanting table going up to level **255**.
Obtain: crafting.
Use: right-click for the GUI; works together with the God Heaven Enchant block.
manual.godofthings.god_furnace:
What: God Furnace -- a super furnace with JEI / EMI recipe lookup.
Obtain: crafting (this is the root advancement of the mod).
Use: right-click for the GUI and insert your input.
manual.godofthings.god_heaven_enchant:
What: God Heaven Enchant -- the companion table for God Enchant.
Obtain: crafting.
Use: right-click for the GUI.
manual.godofthings.god_helmet:
What: God Helmet -- one of the four God Armor pieces.
Obtain: crafting.
Use: with the full set, press O for feature toggles and K for the skill tree (see System - God Armor & Skills).
manual.godofthings.god_invite:
What: God Invite -- gives a mob infinite health.
Obtain: crafting.
Use: right-click a mob; hit feedback is preserved and can be toggled.
manual.godofthings.god_leggings:
What: God Leggings -- one of the four God Armor pieces.
Obtain: crafting.
Use: wear all four pieces to activate set features.
manual.godofthings.god_manual:
What: the in-game manual -- every item/block has an entry, look things up here.
Obtain: 1 book + 4 gold ingots.
Use: right-click it, press P, or run /godofthings manual. Pick a tab and entry on the left; search on top.
manual.godofthings.god_miner:
What: God Miner -- area mining machine with adjustable efficiency/fortune/silk touch and six configurable faces (input pulls in accelerators, output pushes items and fluids). It also works as a pickaxe.
Obtain: crafting.
Use: right-click for parameters and face config; can join an AE2 network.
manual.godofthings.god_note:
What: God Note -- a checklist with checkboxes that supports **sub-tasks** (a main task with sub-tasks, like a heading and subheadings).
Obtain: 3 paper + 1 ink sac + 1 gold ingot.
Use: right-click or press N. Up to 8 books per shelf; drag rows to reorder within the same level; the **+ at the end of a row adds a sub-task and Enter keeps the mode so you can add several**; while editing text, Tab demotes it under the previous task and Shift+Tab promotes it; the **triangle at the start of a row folds / unfolds its sub-tasks**; every delete asks twice. Press M to place the overlay. Content is stored per player in the world save.
manual.godofthings.god_resource:
What: God Resource -- resource duplication machine with 9 input slots.
Obtain: crafting.
Use: put the item to duplicate in an input slot; God Accelerator raises parallelism; can join an AE2 network.
manual.godofthings.god_slaughter:
What: God Slaughter -- area killing (on/off, range 0-1600, looting 0-1600, instant kill).
Obtain: crafting.
Use: GUI for the settings; drops go straight into its own 27-slot infinite storage. Can join an AE2 network.
manual.godofthings.god_spawn_egg:
What: God Spawn Egg -- a spawn-egg duplicator. Put a spawn egg in and it produces the **same** egg; **works with every kind of spawn egg** (vanilla, NeoForge, and modded eggs that follow the vanilla convention of storing the entity data in the item). The whole item stack is copied, data included.
Obtain: 8 emeralds + 1 egg.
Use: right-click for the GUI, put spawn eggs into the 3x3 input slots (up to 9 in parallel; input is not consumed); God Accelerators raise the parallel multiplier; output is pushed downward; can join an AE2 network.
manual.godofthings.god_transmitter:
What: God Transmitter -- wireless FE charging for machines and players, working across dimensions.
Obtain: crafting.
Use: right-click for the four-tab GUI; bind machines with the God Binder.
manual.godofthings.god_unbreakable:
What: makes an item unbreakable -- this is a special crafting recipe, not a usable item.
Obtain: look up the recipe in JEI / EMI (craft the item together with God Unbreakable).
Use: combine with the target item; you get the same item with the unbreakable property.
manual.godofthings.hoyoog_fumo:
What: skin plushie -- a full 12-part player model using the standard 64x64 skin UV; texture is the mod author's own skin.
Obtain: crafting.
Use: right-click to toggle its self-rotation (~6 degrees per tick).
manual.godofthings.space_time_eternity:
What: Space Time Eternity -- while placed it locks world time and weather.
Obtain: crafting.
Use: just place it; no GUI.
manual.godofthings.system.ae2:
Seven production machines (miner / resource / drop / **spawn egg** / slaughter / craft / absorber) can act as AE grid nodes: just connect a cable (one channel) and their output goes into the network. Each GUI has an AE toggle that only controls pushing output into AE.
Note: **AE2 is required** for this mod to start (those block entities implement AE2 interfaces directly); mods.toml declares it as required.
manual.godofthings.system.ae2.title: AE2 integration
manual.godofthings.system.armor_and_skil:
With all four pieces worn:
· Press O for 16 feature toggles: flight, flight inertia, flight mining, invincibility, no death, debuff immunity, no hunger, fire immunity, water breathing, underwater vision, night vision, lava vision, village hero, glowing, gluttony, Ad Astra infinite oxygen. Saved per player.
· Press K for the skill tree: 6 tabs (base stats / special boosts / ultimate nodes / machine resonance / magic boosts / set features); it remembers the tab you were on, skill levels are drag-adjustable and survive death.
manual.godofthings.system.compat:
· Optional integrations: JEI / EMI, Jade, AE2 and its addons (AE2WTLib / ExtendedAE / AppliedFlux / AppMek), Ad Astra, Occultism, Malum, Mystical Agriculture, Goety, Iron's Spells, Ars Nouveau, EnderIO, Mekanism, MI, Productive Bees, Construction Wand, FTB Teams, GTCEu. Missing ones are skipped automatically.
· Note: the dimensions and the plushie are verbatim ports; with useless_mod / ae2lt installed some of our mixins get overridden -- /godofthings doctor names them. This is intended (upstream updates keep being ported).
manual.godofthings.system.compat.title: Compatibility
manual.godofthings.system.dimensions:
· Void Dimension: enter and leave with the Void Teleporter block.
· Useless Dimensions (ported from useless_mod): odd / even / useless, each with its own teleport block.
· Place a teleport block and walk in. The blocks need a pickaxe (they are in the mineable/pickaxe tag).
manual.godofthings.system.faq:
· Machine idle? Check its GUI toggles and range, whether accelerators are inserted, and the six-face I/O config.
· Cannot find something? Use the search box on top of this manual; it searches names and body text.
· Want to know which mods are active, whether our mixins are overridden, or how big the saved data is? Run /godofthings doctor.
· Backups: /godofthings export note and export points (files in <world>/godofthings/exports/).
· Something unclear or missing here? Tell the author, or check the README content table.
manual.godofthings.system.faq.title: FAQ
manual.godofthings.system.getting_starte:
1. Craft the God Furnace first -- it is the root advancement and most materials come from it.
2. Add the God Miner plus God Accelerators: the miner digs, accelerators multiply parallel jobs (x16 each).
3. Missing materials? Use the God Resource (duplication) or God Drop (spawn egg -> vanilla loot table) machine.
4. For convenience: God Note (press N) and this manual (press P).
5. All recipes are in JEI / EMI; this manual only explains what things do.
manual.godofthings.system.keys_and_comma:
[Keys] P manual / N note / M place the note overlay / U waypoints / O armor feature toggles / K armor skill tree / G mode wheel / B wireless logistics / TAB chain mining (hold) / R force mining / PageUp fortune / PageDown silk touch / L flint-and-steel / H farmland mode / V enhanced chain / KP9 force-mining mode.
[Commands] /setpoint <name>, /point <name>, /delpoint <name>; /godofthings doctor, export|import note|points, manual.
Every key can be rebound in Options - Controls - God of Things.
manual.godofthings.system.note:
A checklist with checkboxes, two levels deep: main tasks and sub-tasks. Two ways in: press N or right-click the item.
· Up to 8 books per shelf; the bar on top switches / creates / deletes (delete needs two clicks).
· Drag a row to reorder **within its level** (main tasks among main tasks, sub-tasks within their parent).
· Sub-tasks: click the **+** at the end of a main-task row -- Enter keeps the mode so you can add several; press **Tab** while editing a task's text to demote it under the previous task (Shift+Tab promotes it back).
· The **triangle at the start of a row folds / unfolds sub-tasks** (the overlay follows it too); a main task with sub-tasks shows an (n/m) progress hint.
· Every delete asks twice; deleting a main task removes its sub-tasks as well.
· Overlay: toggle and adjust on the overlay page, or press M to drag it on screen (it snaps to edges).
· The title is customizable; with auto-rename on it follows the current date (e.g. 10.02).
· Content is stored per player; back up with /godofthings export|import note (import auto-backs up first).
